cohort: 100 women diagnosed with pre-eclampsia at a tertiary hospital in Ghana
finding: Hyperuricemia (serum uric acid >375 µmol/L) in women with pre-eclampsia was significantly associated with adverse pregnancy outcomes, including low birth weight, caesarean section, and severe diastolic pressure at birth.
gest_age: Mean gestational age at diagnosis of pre-eclampsia: 32.35±2.66 weeks (preterm) and 35.96±1.94 weeks (term)
birth_weight: Mean birth weight was negatively correlated with maternal serum uric acid levels
